messages:
Joan R.: quick 'tetris' sync — we need to fit the EdgeCloud marketplace tiles together: listing hero, 90s demo clip, SI runbook, partner quote, and embargo window. target publish Thu Aug 29. who picks which tile? :tetris:

Felix M.: I can own demo + screenshots. will produce a 90s clip and three hero frames. need staging creds and canonical prompts. ETA for assets = Wed EOD.

Priya S.: i'll take listing copy + CTAs. drafting two hero options: concise product-forward and enterprise-forward. partner quote required by Tue COB or we fallback.

Noah W.: infra-bot: provisioning staging tenant now. Staging tenant created: rwd-edgecloud-tetris-stg-0829. Creds emailed to Felix M., Noah W. Expires in 72h.

Felix M.: got creds, thanks @infra-bot. screenshot script (example):

```
# screenshot run for demo recording
curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.com/v1/generate \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STG_KEY' \\
  -d '{"model":"rw-accelerate","input":"Summarize the EdgeCloud partnership in two sentences"}'
```

Joan R.: press embargo ask: partner wants Wed 23:59 PT. legal deadline = Mon 12:00 PT. fallback = Redwood-only publish + follow-up partner spotlight.

Priya S.: noted on deadlines. i'll produce both hero variants + localized CTAs (EN/FR/DE) and tag lines needing legal review.

Felix M.: dry run slots: Tue 17:00 PT or Wed 08:00 PT. prefer Tue to allow fixes. will record terminal + screen and produce a trimmed 90s clip.

Noah W.: i'll run perf numbers (rw-accelerate, rw-base-v2) and post p50/p95. will also add an automated teardown to revoke keys 48h after creation.

Joan R.: owners recap -> Hero & CTAs: Priya S.; Demo + screenshots: Felix M.; Staging & perf: Noah W.; Legal & embargo coordination: Joan R. i'll schedule dry run and share runbook. if anyone needs to swap tiles, ping here. :rocket:
